name: Havoth Jair
overview: Havoth Jair refers to a group of small towns or villages east of the Jordan River, named after Jair the son of Manasseh. According to Numbers 32:41 and Deuteronomy 3:14, Jair captured these towns in the region of Bashan and gave them his name, which has persisted to this day. Judges 10:4 further identifies these as thirty cities in the land of Gilead, emphasizing the lasting legacy of Jair’s leadership and the territorial identity associated with his name.
